evidence.reason: Narrowed the fixture oracle handler in _body from `except Exception` to `except ValueError` so only fixer_body's refusal type is recorded while other builder-regression exceptions propagate and fail generation; verified by inspection (the harness permits only git commands, so tests/generation were not run) that all recorded errors in cases.json are the three ValueError messages from crq_repair/drivers/cq.py:86,90,112 and that source-not-string, line-bool and start-bool raise ValueError via the isinstance bool/str guards, leaving the committed fixture unchanged and --check green.
